g.title: PullTrigger
g.text: Daemon asks repeatedly. State-diff suppresses re-fires. Used when no push API exists.

g.title: cluster_poller
g.text: (one task per subscription, or shared with per-row schedule)

g.title: diff
g.text: (the part that makes this a TRIGGER, not just polling)

g.title: note1
g.text: Without it: every poll re-fires the same items forever.
With it: agent runs ONCE per actually-new item.
The state must persist (poller_state table) so a daemon
restart doesn't replay the last known items.

g.title: note2
g.text: Tradeoff: simpler than push (no public URL,
no socket to hold) but slower + more API calls.
